ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Moonlight and reed flowers form a pale scene in which boundaries can look erased. Chan masters use that resemblance, then repeatedly refuse to let resemblance harden into identity: the same pair can be said to share one color, not resemble each other, or remain a place from which one must get out.
EvidenceBody: Zhuanyu Guanheng calls moonlight and reed flowers one fresh color while saying there are not two sides. Huanyou Zhengchuan makes the pair nod inside his answer on the five ranks. Yushan Shangsi warns that merely invoking it enters an old groove. Xueyan Zuqin says moon, reeds, and egret are alike, then asks how many people cannot leave that ground and values his own exposition at less than half a coin. Foyan Qingyuan puts moon and reeds beside red smartweed; Binya Jian sets them on the two banks after dismissing fixed acceptance and rejection.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: A landscape image becomes a live test of whether apparent sameness has turned into another verbal resting place.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The corpus blocks a flat equation of whiteness with one doctrine: several witnesses explicitly say the moon and reeds are not the same or warn against remaining in that scene.

ComparedThings: the literal words of the image
DifferentThingTest.Reason: The noun pair remains one landscape image; contrary appraisals of sameness and difference are deployments of that image, not different referents.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: The aliases expose natural English lookup routes for the exact image 明月蘆花 without adding another sense.

ModifierControls.reason: Pale color and resemblance are load-bearing in this image; the retained witnesses deliberately include 一色 and 一樣 alongside 不似 and 入窠臼 so whiteness is not flattened into identity.

FamilyControls.reason: The retained 明月蘆花 witnesses cover distinct utterances and contrasts; parallel recensions are not counted as separate deployment classes.
